text.description_html:
Prime Hardware MDS014U15, Low Profile Magnetic Door Stop and Holder

The Satin Nickel finished magnet door stop and holder is great to use when you need a very low profile floor mounted base to reduce the risk of potential tripping or to ease floor cleaning. The magnet is screwed on bottom of the door. When the magnet approaches the strike, the arm raises up to 3/4 inch to stop and hold the door. Packaged complete with mounting anchors and screws.

Specifications for the MDS014U15 Low Profile Magnetic Door Stop:

  • Strike Base Diameter: 2-3/8"
  • Strike Base Height: 1/8"
  • Magnet Base Length: 2-1/4"
  • Magnet Base Height: 3/4"
  • Magnet Base Projection: 1"
  • Maximum Door Clearance to Strike: 3/4"
  • The magnet must be mounted within 3/4" of the strike plate. If the bottom of your door has more than 3/4" of gap to the floor it will NOT work properly.
  • Finish: Satin Nickel

Sold Individually
